lines: וְכֵן אַהֲבָה וְלֹא לְעֵת נְזִיפָה וָכַעַס

review: The hymn is the call to evangelise: 1:1–7 is Isa 6:8 with Rom 10:14–15 and Matt 28:19, 2:1–7 is Matt 9:36–38 with Rom 10:20, 3:1–7 is Matt 25:36 with Jas 2:15–16, and 4:1–7 is Mal 3:10 with 2 Cor 9:6–11.

The last two lines of each stanza are the printed repetition of the closing phrase (هَيَّا فَكُنْ أَمِين / وَأتِ بِهِمْ لِيَ / وَلَيْسَ لِلْمَلَام / وَالْخِصْبِ وَالنَّمَاء); the payload keeps both the long line and its short echo, since the echo is what the book sets to the tune's cadence.
1:5–6 keep the print's claim that angels are not preachers, with the Hebrew מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם … אֵינָם מְבַשְּׂרִים, so the line is a commission and not a comparison of ranks.
